name: clawd
description: Clawd, a little crab above your prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing (or a garden, or Moss)

utc_offset.title: UTC offset
utc_offset.description: Your time zone's offset from UTC, like +05:30, for Clawd's sun and moon

leave_at.title: Leave time
leave_at.description: Optional: when you leave work on weekdays, as 24-hour HH:MM, for Clawd's going-home nudges. Empty turns them off

music.title: Music
music.description: Optional: artists or songs for Clawd's songbook, comma-separated. Empty uses its built-in songs; set, it costs one small Haiku call a day

lastfm_user.title: Last.fm user
lastfm_user.description: Optional: your Last.fm username, so the songbook follows this week's plays. Needs the API key too; adds a Last.fm check every 3 hours and a Haiku call when your plays change

lastfm_api_key.title: Last.fm API key
lastfm_api_key.description: Optional: a read-only Last.fm API key (last.fm/api/accounts), kept in secure storage
